description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary attribute) were incorrectly assigned to the forward pass parameters `self.x` and `self.x0` instead of the class dictionary attributes `self.resid_lambdas`. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step with empty tensors, crashing the training loop. By correctly assigning `self.resid_lambdas` (the class attribute) to the forward pass parameters, the optimizer can initialize gradients from the first step, restoring stable val_bpb to ~0.9912.
